verdict: INVALID for concluding hardness (researcher's own assessment, confirmed by code audit)

defect_1_wrong_min_cost_oracle.location: observatory/chains/master.py (as of commit 418204a), probe_typed_completion, lines ~260-268: `for size in range(1, n_evidence+1): ... if best is not None: break`
defect_1_wrong_min_cost_oracle.description: The 'exact' minimum-cost search enumerated item subsets in increasing cardinality order and stopped at the FIRST cardinality with any feasible cover, never comparing against cheaper covers reachable only at a larger cardinality. This is minimum-cardinality-then-cheapest-at-that-cardinality, not minimum cost.

numeric_reproduction.instance: 3 obligations; one item covers all 3 at cost 2.25 (found at size 1); three singleton items cover them individually at cost 0.25 each, true minimum 0.75 (only reachable at size 3, never inspected)

defect_1_wrong_min_cost_oracle.artifact_level_evidence: 336 of 3000 recorded draws (11.2%) show greedy_cost strictly LESS than the reported 'exact' completion_cost in campaigns_20260904_003028.jsonl -- a logical impossibility if completion_cost were truly minimal, and direct proof of the bug already visible in the invalid artifact itself.

defect_2_typing_not_enforced.location: observatory/chains/master.py (as of commit 418204a), probe_typed_completion, lines 248-253: `obligations = list(range(n_obligations))` (untyped integers) and `cov = frozenset(o for o in obligations if rng.random() < 0.45)` (coverage assigned with no reference to the item's TYPES[i % len(TYPES)] label)
defect_2_typing_not_enforced.description: Obligations carried no required type at all; the per-item type label was purely descriptive (used only for the post-hoc 'types_used' diagnostic) and never gated which obligations an item could discharge. Any evidence item of any declared type could discharge any obligation.
defect_2_typing_not_enforced.measured_fraction: Not well-defined as a per-draw violation rate against this code's own model, because the code never modeled a per-obligation required type to violate -- the constraint was absent, not merely unenforced on some fraction of draws. As an observable proxy: 2567 of 3000 draws (85.6%) in campaigns_20260904_003028.jsonl have MASTER.typed_completion.types_used > 1, i.e. the reported solution mixed evidence declared with different type labels with zero computational gating -- consistent with typing having no causal effect on the completion in the large majority of draws.

corrected_successor.code: research_chains/novelty_completion.py: minimum_cost_typed_completion (exact DP over the obligation-coverage bitmask, no cardinality-based early exit) and greedy_typed_completion, both validating item.evidence_type against each discharged obligation's required type and raising ValueError on mismatch; observatory/chains/master.py: probe_typed_completion now assigns each obligation an explicit required type and calls these two functions.
